title: Apply the fair value option for liabilities

items.concept: Initial recognition at discount; effective-interest subsequent measurement schedule; period-end fair value option adjusting JE (general risk → NI); maturity settlement
Number-variant twin — initial recognition; subsequent AC schedule; period-end FVO adjusting JEs; disposal/early settlement JE
Period-end adjusting JE emphasis — general risk → NI vs instrument-specific credit risk → OCI; multi-period FVA schedule; disposal/settlement with AOCI reclassification to NI
General risk → net income; instrument-specific credit risk → OCI
Fair Value Adjustment bridges amortized cost to fair value; election is instrument-by-instrument and irrevocable
